title: Colorado PUC Decision C26-0018-I: Interim Commission Decision Granting Unopposed Motion to Approve Consensus Procedural Schedule and Adopting Procedural Schedule
summary: Interim Commission Decision Granting Unopposed Motion to Approve Consensus Procedural Schedule and Adopting Procedural Schedule
text:
Decision No. C26-0018-I 
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF COLORADO 
PROCEEDING NO. 25A-0500E 
IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF BLACK HILLS COLORADO ELECTRIC, LLC, 
FOR APPROVAL OF ITS ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT TARIFF (EDR). 
INTERIM COMMISSION DECISION 
GRANTING UNOPPOSED MOTION TO APPROVE 
CONSENSUS PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE AND 
ADOPTING PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE 
Issued Date: 
January 9, 2026 
Adopted Date: January 7, 2026 

I. 
BY THE COMMISSION 
A. 
Statement, Findings, and Conclusions 
1. 
On November 25, 2025, Black Hills Colorado Electric, LLC, doing business as 
Black Hills Energy (“Black Hills” or the “Company”), filed a Verified Application for approval 
of a proposed Economic Development Rate Tariff (“Application”). The Company filed the 
Application pursuant to §§ 40-3-104.3(6) and (7), C.R.S., (“EDR Statute”). 
2. 
This Decision adopts a procedural schedule for this Proceeding consistent with the 
timeline for the consideration of the Application pursuant to the EDR Statute. 
3. 
An en banc remote evidentiary hearing is scheduled for the days of 
March 4-5, 2026. 
4. 
In Attachment A to this Decision, the Commission provides instruction for how the 
remote evidentiary hearing will be conducted using the Zoom platform. Relatedly, in Attachment 
B to this Decision, the Commission sets forth procedures for the electronic submission of exhibits.

B. 
Discussion 
5. 
By Decision No. C25-0928-I, issued on December 22, 2025, the Commission set 
the Application for hearing before the Commission en banc and, as an initial procedural step, 
required Black Hills to file additional Supplemental Direct Testimony. The Commission further 
suspended the Commission’s determination of the completeness of the Application by concluding 
that more information related to the Application is necessary pursuant to Rule 1303(c)(IV) of the 
Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, 4 Code of Colorado Regulations 723-1. The 
Commission also directed Black Hills and the intervening parties to confer on a proposed 
procedural schedule and ordered the Company to make a related filing in the Proceeding. 
6. 
On December 30, 2025, Black Hills filed an Unopposed Motion to Approve 
Consensus Procedural Schedule (“Procedural Schedule Motion”) with a request to waive response 
time to the motion. 
C. 
Findings and Conclusions 
7. 
We find the proposed procedural schedule set forth in the Procedural Schedule 
Motion is reasonable and should be adopted. The proposed hearing dates of March 4-5, 2026, will 
accommodate a final decision on the Application to be rendered by the deadline in the EDR 
Statute.1 
8. 
Because the Procedural Schedule Motion is unopposed, we find good cause to 
waive response time. 

1 Section 40-3-104.3(6)(b)(VI)(A), C.R.S., requires the Commission to approve or deny an 
inaugural application to establish an economic development rate tariff within 120 days after a notice period 
of 14 days from the date of the application filing. Because Black Hills filed the Application on 
November 25, 2025, the deadline for a Commission decision addressing the Application is April 16, 2026, 
as recognized in the Procedural Schedule Motion.

9. 
Accordingly, we establish the following procedural schedule for this matter:

Date 
Supplemental Direct Testimony 
December 31, 2025 
Answer Testimony 
January 30, 2026 
Rebuttal & Cross-Answer Testimony 
February 20, 2026

Prehearing Motions

Stipulations and Settlement Agreements

Responses to Prehearing Motions 
March 3, 2026 
Settlement Testimony 
March 3, 2026

March 3, 2026 
Non-Testimonial Exhibits

Remote En Banc Evidentiary Hearing 
March 4-5, 2026

March 20, 2026 
10. 
The discovery procedures outlined in Rule 1405 of the Rules of Practice and 
Procedure shall apply to the conduct of discovery, except as modified as follows. Responses to 
discovery on Direct Testimony and Answer Testimony shall be due in seven business days instead 
of 10 business days, and responses to discovery on Rebuttal Testimony and Cross-Answer 
Testimony shall be due in five calendar days instead of seven business days. 
11. 
The Commission schedules a fully remote en banc evidentiary hearing for the days 
of March 4-5, 2026, using the video-conference Zoom platform. To minimize the potential that 
the remote hearing may be disrupted by non-participants, Commission staff will distribute the link 
and meeting ID to attend the hearing to the parties by email approximately one week before the 
hearing, and the parties and witnesses are prohibited from distributing that information to anyone 
not participating in the hearing. 
12. 
Attachment A to this Decision provides the information addressing how to use the 
Zoom platform to participate in the evidentiary hearing. Attachment B provides instructions

governing the preparation and presentation of electronic exhibits at the hearing. Parties are directed 
to review and follow all requirements in this Decision and Attachments A and B. 
13. 
The party initiating the proceeding is assigned hearing exhibit numbers 100 to 199. 
14. 
Each intervening person is assigned a block of 100 hearing exhibit numbers 
(e.g., 300-399, 400-499, etc.) in the chronological order that notices of intervention by right and 
petitions for permissive intervention are filed, as reflected in the Commission’s E-Filings System. 
Parties shall rely upon the Commission’s E-Filings system to determine sequencing of requests for 
intervention (i.e., without regard to whether or when the interventions were granted). To determine 
the sequencing and avoid duplicative use of blocks, parties are encouraged to confer as needed. 
15. 
The Commission will determine the completeness of the Application by separate 
decision. 
II. 
ORDER 
A. 
It Is Ordered That: 
1. 
The Unopposed Motion to Approve Consensus Procedural Schedule (“Procedural 
Schedule Motion”) filed by Black Hills Colorado Electric, LLC, doing business as Black Hills 
Energy (“Black Hills”) on December 30, 2025, is granted, consistent with the discussion above. 
2. 
Response time to the Procedural Schedule Motion is waived. 
3. 
The procedural schedule found in the Procedural Schedule Motion is adopted, 
consistent with the discussion above. 
4. 
The Commission will determine the completeness of the Application by separate 
decision.

5. 
A remote en banc evidentiary hearing is scheduled as follows: 
DATE: 
March 4-5, 2026 
TIME: 
1:00 p.m. until 5:00 p.m. on March 4, 2026 
9:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m. on March 5, 2026 
WEBCAST: Commission Hearing Room A 
METHOD: 
Join by videoconference using Zoom at the link to be provided to 
parties by email from Commission Administrative Staff. 
6. 
All participants must comply with the requirements in Attachments A and B to this 
Decision, which are incorporated into this Decision. 
7. 
Rules 1405(b) and (d), 4 Code of Colorado Regulations 723-1, governing 
discovery procedures, shall apply except as modified by this Decision. 
8. 
This Decision is effective immediately upon its Issued Date. 
B.

January 7, 2025.
